schema: ER12 independent full-pipeline semantic assessment v1
review_scope: One ordinary three-stage full pipeline only: investigator discovery/draft → critic critique → reviser final. No other arms/results/history or ER11.
judgment_reason: No remaining material source error, scientific omission or unsupported consequential final decision was found after all six axes and exact plan clauses were assessed. Specific nonmaterial depth/fidelity and lineage limits are retained. Original full 60-minute use is UNMET separately; semantic qualification is not an unqualified full-duration delivery pass.

control.delivery: COMPLETE authored discovery/draft/critique/final/maps/indexes and assignments/input maps/freezes inspected

material_findings.domain: original time/scope obligation, separate from source judgment
material_findings.status: UNMET; false fulfilled label corrected in final
material_findings.materiality: Literal original full-window obligation not delivered
evidence: saved investigator native activation 06:24:35Z and 1316s reported completion elapsed

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.rationale: The final is a qualified-partner research proposal, maintains four outcomes, useful alternatives, specified covariates, history inquiry, transfer limits and later observations. Negative constraints are respected. Every exact plan sentence/bullet is mapped below. Site history and owner permissions/priority are legitimate external unknowns, not missing fabricated work. Literal full-duration use is unmet and reported separately, not waived by the corrected final label.
limits: T-01 original duration unmet; separate time/scope result

axes.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axes.rationale: Independent primary retrieval supports final conditional capture, inlet debris/grade, soil/underdrain, antecedent/storm and intended-bypass distinctions. Local thresholds, values and causes are not asserted. 48 hours remains contextual; Queens capture is of received water versus tributary-area capture, not a local performance promise. USGS event examples independently checked by reviewer. Earlier study-count/attribution slips do not survive as consequential final claims.
limits: No article data reanalysis; live revision IDs unavailable

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, history and opportunity breadth
axes.rationale: Discovery yields non-obvious distinctions and actual analogous evidence: capture can fail despite infiltration; intended offline bypass; inlet orientation/divots; pretreatment maintenance; underdrain paths; Portland/New York iterative inlet history; contrasting USGS studies and visual versus quantitative assessment. Competing entry/routing, maintenance/soil and observation-first routes have meaningful decision roles. Conditional accepted bypass and qualified diagnostics avoid a preselected repair.
limits: L-03 concrete municipal histories compressed in final; supported meaning and map remain

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.rationale: CR-01 correctly rejects the fulfilled-duration label, CR-02 corrects sumps typo, CR-03 appropriately retains genuinely unavailable site inputs. All three final dispositions are defensible; no criticism forces scope reduction or an unauthorized repair. No correction to hypothetical brief facts is warranted. Table assertions about generation and untimed-photo coverage are stronger than prose depth and are recorded as nonmaterial limits.
limits: Time criticism does not itself establish a scientific source defect
CR-01 correction cannot recover elapsed time

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery, draft, critique and final
axes.rationale: Four outcomes, conditional alternatives, source/site conditions, records requests, owner choices, event design, uncertainty, no-test/no-design boundaries and validation status survive in self-contained final prose. Reviser namespaces preserve S/C IDs and access limitations. Specific municipal history details are compressed, while the resulting capture/safety/maintenance tradeoff remains. Final avoids rather than repeats earlier framework attribution and Madison total-count imprecision.
limits: L-03 reduced final detail on named public inlet sequences
Candidate USGS independent recheck remained limited; reviewer check is separate

axes.name: Proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.rationale: Proposed 6–10-event exploratory observations, representative interval rain, fixed views/references, separate outcomes, exact check times/misses, maintenance-period comparisons and stop/escalation are meaningful. They discriminate approach/entry from retention/outlet families, not infiltration rate, causal compaction, volume, pollutant or compliance. No numerical pass/fail performance oracle is asserted. Executed work is bounded source/document review; field, model, test and local-history verification remain unperformed.
limits: Exploratory count/times are proposals, not power or validated monitoring sufficiency
Causal attribution needs further approved measurement/control; final acknowledges this

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: A neighborhood demonstration rain garden appears to receive water through one curb opening during some storms, while flow passes the opening during others.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Intermittent reported entry is a hypothetical observation, not verified site data.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Volunteers recently added mulch and cleared nearby leaves, and a construction delivery may have compacted part of the edge.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Mulch/leaf work and possible delivery compaction remain leads to a documented timeline.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The city partner wants a research proposal before considering repairs.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Records/observation proposal precedes any repair selection.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: There are no surveyed levels, rainfall records, soil tests, or catchment measurements.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No levels, rain, soils or catchment numbers are manufactured.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: All site details are hypothetical.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Explicitly hypothetical throughout.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Use the full 60-minute research window to develop a proposal that distinguishes runoff capture problems from storage or infiltration limitations.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Capture versus storage/infiltration is separated. Literal full duration was not used; final corrects fulfilled label. About 29m40s was available after recorded investigator activation, not actual research occupancy. Timing is evaluated separately.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Explain mechanisms and useful alternatives, investigate installation and maintenance history, and propose a modest later observation or test program.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Mechanisms and alternatives are substantive, history inquiry is specific, and the later observation design is modest. Real site history cannot be investigated empirically for a synthetic site with no records.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The deliverable should support discussion with a qualified site partner, not provide a construction or drainage design.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Qualified-partner discussion; no design dimensions, test execution or drainage work.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Treat entry capture, temporary storage, infiltration, and downstream effects as separate outcomes.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Four separate outcomes, including outlet/underdrain and downstream route. Drawdown is a proxy, not an infiltration measurement.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Compare inlet or surface-routing ideas with maintenance or soil-management investigation and a useful observation-first alternative.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Four conditional rows compare entry/routing review, maintenance/soil inquiry, and observation first.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Consider storm intensity and duration, antecedent wetness, sediment or leaf accumulation, and local geometry rather than attributing the problem solely to compaction.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Timing/intensity, antecedent proxy, debris, geometry and maintenance periods are recorded; compaction is one unverified hypothesis.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Investigate original installation and recent maintenance history and explain the limits of transferring evidence from other rain gardens.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Specific as-built/construction/O&M requests and transfer limits are provided; no actual local records exist in input.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Propose comparisons across events, feasible measurements, uncertainties, and an escalation or stop condition; distinguish proposed field validation from research or modeling actually executed.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Natural event contrasts, feasible categorical/level/rain observations, missing checks, uncertainty and stop/escalation conditions; no executed field/model claim.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Do not excavate, change a curb, redirect runoff, perform infiltration tests, or prescribe final civil-engineering dimensions.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No excavation, curb work, runoff redirection, infiltration test or final dimensions in this study. Qualified future characterization is conditional, not an instruction to run a prohibited test.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Do not claim flood protection, pollutant removal, or regulatory compliance from visible ponding or a literature example.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No flood, pollutant or regulatory inference from ponding or other gardens.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Do not fabricate rainfall, soil properties, catchment area, grade, or construction damage.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No site rain, soil, area, grade or damage invented. Proposed counts/times are explicitly study-design choices.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: We do not know the drainage boundary, slopes, inlet geometry, plant and soil layers, overflow route, storm distribution, public-access limits, or observation permissions.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Boundary/grades/inlet prevent capture calculation or inlet remedy; layers/outlet govern drawdown interpretation; overflow route prevents downstream claims; storm classes limit comparison; access/permission gate observations.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The city has not identified whether entry failure or slow drawdown is its main concern.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Ask city about entry versus drawdown and design-acceptable bypass; keep all four outcomes regardless.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: State the consequences for study design.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Consequences are concrete calculation, diagnosis, routing and access limits, not generic caution.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: What first research and observation sequence would distinguish water failing to enter the feature from water entering but being retained or transmitted differently than expected?
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Records plus event observation distinguish absent approach/entry from retained or transmitted water.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The relevant storm class, owner objective, authorized access, measurement equipment, and minimum evidence for escalation remain unresolved.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Event classes, objective, permission and equipment remain explicit gates; local criterion/escalation observations are named.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The proposal should preserve an observation-first route while comparing practical interventions conditionally and exposing data gaps.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Observation first remains useful alongside conditional alternatives and specific data gaps.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Investigate inlet clearing and documented maintenance, surface-routing or inlet geometry assessment, soil condition and infiltration inquiry, and staged event observation before changing anything.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Maintenance history, entry geometry, soil/media/outlet inquiry and staged observation are compared; study does not itself clear or change anything.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Accepting limited capture for some storms could be a useful baseline if it is consistent with the actual objective.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Limited capture baseline depends on owner objective and design intent, not an assumed complete-capture goal.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: A qualified survey or diagnostic study may be more valuable than an immediate repair.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Survey or diagnostic follows inconclusive observation; immediate repair is not privileged.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: No inlet, soil treatment, or retrofit is preselected.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No predetermined intervention.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Develop an account of runoff generation, approach flow, entry geometry, storage, overflow, and soil-water movement.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Approach/entry/storage/overflow/media pathways are clear. Runoff generation is thinner: event and contributing-area/loading questions are named, but surface cover/connectivity and initial losses are not developed. This limits breadth, without supporting a wrong flow estimate or disabling the first capture-versus-drawdown study.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Separate observed bypass from inferred infiltration failure.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Bypass does not diagnose infiltration failure.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Storm characteristics and antecedent conditions can alter several processes at once.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Explicit covariates, confounding and cautious event comparisons.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Propose evidence that could discriminate mechanisms, and state when a simple water balance would be informative or unsupported.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Entry observations, ponding/recession and routes distinguish broad mechanism families. Current water balance unsupported; later quantitative balance requires qualified inputs/outputs/storage measurements.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Investigate design intent, as-built information, maintenance dates, sediment accumulation, and possible traffic or delivery effects.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Actual design and work records unavailable; records request covers every named lead rather than inferring history.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Public implementation reports need catchment, geometry, event conditions, operation, and measured outcomes to support transfer.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Other studies kept in their catchment/geometry/event/operation domain; no numeric transfer.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The recollection of compaction is a lead rather than a confirmed defect.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Unverified lead; no local soil defect asserted.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Historical ponding photographs without timing or input conditions may fail to distinguish capture from drawdown.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Dated/time-stamped event photos and separate input/outcome logs implement this concern. The exact warning about old untimed photos appears only as a disposition assertion, not a developed explanatory sentence. No inference actually relies on such photos.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: A later authorized study could document event conditions, entry or bypass observations, ponding and drawdown, and stable reference points across several storms.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Safe fixed baseline, event conditions, entry/bypass, ponding and recession observations across events; proposed only.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Explain observation timing, safe access, comparison limits, and what would trigger a qualified survey or soil investigation rather than a volunteer repair.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Post-event checks, exact times/misses, safe access, confounding, and escalation to survey/media/outlet investigation are explicit.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: An assumed water balance or diagram executed in the hour is desk work only.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No executed balance or diagram claimed; future assumed desk work is distinguished from field validation.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Field capture, infiltration performance, downstream benefit, and pollutant outcomes remain unvalidated.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No measured local capture, infiltration, downstream or pollutant result.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Authoring status: only synthetic input files have been prepared.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Synthetic-case preparation is distinct from candidate desk research.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: No scientific search, pilot, experiment, data collection, implementation, or performance validation has been performed for this case.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Statement refers to case authoring, not a prohibition on later researcher search. Final distinguishes later source review.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: Future researchers must state the actual extent of any work they execute.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Actual desk research and access failures vs unperformed site validation explicitly described. Raw execution audit is unavailable; scientific status is accurately bounded.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The topic is sized for a full 60-minute research-and-proposal session: substantive evidence discovery, causal reasoning, comparison of useful alternatives, implementation/history investigation, and a coherent later validation design.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Substantive research/proposal content remains broad; explicit original 60-minute use is unmet and remains a separate time obligation.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: The proposal may contain reasoned provisional choices, but the case provides no predetermined winner.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: Records/observation first is a provisional sequence; no retrofit winner.

exact_plan_clause_dispositions.exact_clause: It requests no product build.
exact_plan_clause_dispositions.independent_reason: No product/build/deployment invented.

limitations.finding: Runoff generation is represented mainly by contributing area/loading, rain and approach-flow questions. The final’s claim to preserve a complete generation account is stronger than its explanation of surface-cover/connectivity and initial losses.

limitations.finding: The exact caveat about untimed historical ponding photographs is asserted in the plan-disposition table but developed mainly implicitly through dated records, time-stamped photos and event input logs.

independent_sources.title: Evaluating Green Infrastructure Stormwater Capture Performance under Extreme Precipitation
independent_sources.publisher: Drexel author publication record; Journal of Extreme Events / World Scientific
independent_sources.type_and_domain: official primary guidance or primary research record; urban stormwater/bioretention
independent_sources.reviewer_operation: independent retrieval and substantive inspection of specified governing passages; no field work or source-data reanalysis
independent_sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: One Queens facility monitored 2011–14, sandy in-situ soils, dimensionless 3.8:1 hydraulic loading ratio. Nearly all runoff received through the inlet infiltrated there; bypass limited capture. Duration, total rain and peak-hourly intensity were associated with capture; maintenance/vegetation inference was anecdotal and future work.
independent_sources.checked_claim_and_assessment: Final accurately limits the finding to capture versus infiltration and covariate logging. It transfers no capture percentage, overflow volume, infiltration rate or causal maintenance effect.
independent_sources.applicability_limits: Full article/data not independently reanalyzed. Abstract formula placeholders prevent checking exact sample sizes/p-value; final makes no such numeric claim. Facility also received some runoff from outside designed tributary area, another transfer limitation.
